About

About this website

This website presents the research, people, publications, and contact information of the Siggers Lab at Boston University.

The original Jekyll codebase was adapted from open-source academic lab templates shared by the labs of D. Allan Drummond and Trevor Bedford, and subsequently used by the Sanders Lab. The design and content have been updated for the Siggers Lab while preserving acknowledgement of those original template authors.
